functions.deepkeep_check:
return function(resp)
  local result = {
    block = false,
    block_message = "DeepKeep allowed the request",
    masked = false,
    block_reason = "",
    block_detail = "",
  }

  if not resp or not resp.flagged then
    return result
  end

  local priority = { block = 4, redact = 3, modify = 2, alert = 1 }
  local best_action = "alert"
  local best_score = 1
  local best_name = "DeepKeep"
  local reasons = {}

  for _, item in ipairs(resp.verbosity or EMPTY_T) do
    local details = item.details or {}
    local action = tostring(details.guardrail_action or "alert")
    local score = priority[action] or 1

    if score > best_score then
      best_score = score
      best_action = action
      best_name = item.guardrail_name or best_name
    end

    if item.guardrail_name then
      table.insert(reasons, item.guardrail_name)
    end
  end

  result.block = best_action == "block"
  result.masked = best_action == "redact" or best_action == "modify"
  result.block_reason = best_action
  result.block_detail = table.concat(reasons, ", ")

  if result.block then
    result.block_message = best_name .. " blocked the request"
  elseif result.masked then
    result.block_message = best_name .. " requested masking"
  else
    result.block_message = best_name .. " raised an alert"
  end

  return result
end
